==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[Yoannh the Rebuilder]] ([[The Ruptured Heart]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.
==Notes==
*This skill will increase the damage done by a [[minion]], but not by an [[animal companion]].
**A maxed (+4) Heroic Refrain increases the damage of a Level 20 Bone Fiend by around 13%.
*At 16 Leadership, this skill may be cast by the player character on themselves to raise their Leadership attribute to 19. This meets the threshold required for Heroic Refrain to provide a +4 boost to all attributes.  	
**Another subsequent casting on the player will then also raise their Leadership attribute to 20, maximising energy gain from casting party wide shouts and chants.
* This skill only increases the primary profession's [[primary attribute]] and primary and secondary profession's [[secondary attribute]]s, it doesn't increase attributes obtained through [[blessing]]s or [[Seven Weapons Stance]].

==Trivia==
*This is the only skill that can increase the attribute rank of an ally. 
*This skill uses an altered version of an unimplemented ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' skill icon.
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
*The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
